(compare Id HWB 330 ) as proposing closed bridal chamber (ideogram = closed chamber ), from √ כלא or כלה , thence bride (compare harem ); according to RS K 136 f. 292 כַּלָּה = one closed in , or reserved (that is, for her husband); Ges and others one crowned (compare Aramaic etc. כלילא crown ), but form much against this; Nö ZMG 1886, 737 'ventures no explanation').
